categories.main_business_segments: STARTS CORPORATION INC. operates through ten main business segments: construction, rental brokerage, sales brokerage, property management, real estate development (condominiums and houses), publishing, hotel and leisure, elderly care and childcare, financial and consulting services, and merchandise/cultural businesses. Each segment is managed through a network of subsidiaries and affiliates, both domestically and internationally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages expertise in earthquake-resistant (seismic isolation) construction, passive design for residential comfort, and integrated property management systems. It utilizes proprietary IT systems for real estate management and brokerage, and emphasizes environmentally friendly building methods, such as ZEH/ZEB and renewable energy installations. The group also develops and operates digital platforms for publishing and reservation services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include individual property owners, corporate clients (for office, housing, and asset management), tenants, homebuyers, elderly and childcare facility users, and consumers of media and leisure services. The company serves residential, commercial, and institutional real estate markets, as well as hospitality, publishing, and financial services sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s core operations are in Japan, with a strong presence in the Tokyo metropolitan area and major regional cities. Internationally, it operates in 12 Asian countries, North and South America, Europe, and Oceania, with subsidiaries and offices in cities such as Honolulu, New York, Shanghai, Singapore, Sydney, and Phnom Penh.
categories.supply_chain_position: STARTS operates across the entire real estate value chain, from upstream (construction and development) through midstream (brokerage and property management) to downstream (end-user services such as hotels, elderly care, and publishing). It also provides asset management and consulting, positioning itself as an integrated service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding fee-based businesses (brokerage, management), enhancing stock-type recurring revenue, developing environmentally sustainable and disaster-resilient buildings, and strengthening digital transformation in real estate and media. The group emphasizes human resource development, regional network expansion, and integrated solutions for asset management and succession. There is no significant mention of traditional R&D, but innovation is pursued through business model and service development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through construction contracts, real estate brokerage commissions, property management fees, rental income, sales of developed properties, publishing and advertising, hotel and leisure services, elderly care and childcare fees, financial product commissions, and consulting fees. Franchise fees and licensing are also part of the model, especially in the brokerage network.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include large Japanese real estate and property management firms such as Mitsui Fudosan, Sumitomo Realty & Development, and Tokyu Fudosan, as well as specialized brokerage and management companies. STARTS positions itself as a comprehensive 'total solution' and 'lifetime customer' company, differentiating through its integrated, multi-segment approach and regional network.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales were approximately 232.9 billion yen, with operating profit of 32.6 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent shareholders of 24.3 billion yen. The company has shown steady growth in profit and assets over the past five years, with a workforce of 4,683 employees (plus 4,227 temporary staff), and a strong balance sheet with over 333 billion yen in total assets and a rising equity ratio.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: STARTS emphasizes its ability to provide one-stop, lifetime solutions for asset utilization, combining real estate, finance, and lifestyle services. Its unique value lies in its integrated service offering, regional and international network, focus on customer lifetime value, and commitment to sustainability and community-based business. The company highlights its expertise in disaster-resilient and eco-friendly buildings, digital platforms, and comprehensive property management.
